title: Modules package configuration
summary: A module is a group of Terraform configuration files used together. The current folder is the root module; other modules can be called from it.
introduction: A module is a group of Terraform configuration files used together. The current folder is the root module; other modules can be called from it. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
